latest_release.body:
**Compatible with PHP 8.2 to 8.5**

## Features & Maintenance

- Bump Docker to PHP 8.5, use custom ICU data to fix timezone issues in some countries (#6318)
- Search invoice history by invoice number (#6287) - thanks @Deniiz23 
- Highlight unpaid invoices in listings
- Run the search on Enter instead of saving the filter as default (invoice & export screen) (#6291) - thanks @dgesteves 
- Run `pnpm lint` during CI
- Updated translations (#6292) (#6306)
- Fix twig deprecations: missing default parameter in macros
- Improved invoice overdue calculation (internal API bug, no visible changes)
- Bumped frontend and composer packages

## Bugfixes

- Keep the calendar month in the URL on reload (#6324) - thanks @shu-chen-dot-ca 
- Use correct TTL settings for "password reset" links
- Reduce default TTL for "password reset" links to 0.5h
- Use consistent currency aware monetary rounding half-up, mainly for invoices (#6317)
- Memory safe export preview (#6295)
- Do not fail on unpersisted entities in rate calculation (mass import via internal API)

## 🚨 Security

- Disable login route if SAML is active and user disabled form login (#6311) - thanks @mrtxmrtx
- Validate custom-field values submitted via API (#6301) - thanks @wleeaf and @manus-pi
- Fix locale route matching in global firewall - thanks @petertornstrand 
- Harden twig security policy - thanks @manus-pi

You can read more about all security reports [here](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/bughunter.html#published-vulnerabilities) or grab this [RSS feed](https://www.kimai.org/security.xml) to get notified about new published advisories.

Also involved in this release: @kevinpapst, @weblate, Andrei Stepanov, @aspopovic, @Deniiz23, @dgesteves, Gabriel, Phil, testecelular and @Watchman89

detail.readme:
Kimai
#1 Open-Source Time-Tracker

Kimai is a professional grade time-tracking application, free and open-source. It handles use-cases of freelancers as well as companies with dozens or hundreds of users. Kimai was build to track your project times and ships with many advanced features, including but not limited to: JSON API, invoicing, data exports, multi-timer and punch-in punch-out mode, tagging, multi-user - multi-timezones - multi-language ([over 30 translations existing](https://hosted.weblate.org/projects/kimai/)!), authentication via SAML/LDAP/Database, two-factor authentication (2FA) with TOTP, customizable role and team permissions, responsive design, user/customer/project specific rates, advanced search & filtering, money and time budgets, advanced reporting, support for [plugins](https://www.kimai.org/store/) and so much more. ### Links - [Home](https://www.kimai.org) — Kimai project homepage - [Blog](https://www.kimai.org/en/blog/) — Read the latest news - [Documentation](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/) — Learn how to use Kimai - [Newsletter](https://www.kimai.org/en/newsletter) - Subscribe and get notified about new releases and important updates ### Requirements - PHP 8.2 minimum with support for 8.3, 8.4, 8.5 - MariaDB / MySQL: oldest maintained LTS release (MariaDB >= [10.6](https://endoflife.date/mariadb) or MySQL >= [8.4](https://endoflife.date/mysql)) or newer - A webserver and subdomain (subdirectory is not supported) - PHP extensions: `gd`, `intl`, `json`, `mbstring`, `pdo`, `tokenizer`, `xml`, `xsl`, `zip` ## Installation - Caddy with Docker-Compose at [Hetzner](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/hosting-hetzner-cloud.html) and [DigitalOcean](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/hosting-digital-ocean.html) - [SSH setup](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/installation.html) with Git and Composer - [Docker images](https://hub.docker.com/r/kimai/kimai2) with FPM only or incl. Apache - [Synology](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/synology.html) user can host the Docker version - [Developer setups](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/developers.html) if you want to create Kimai integrations There are more documented ways for [on-premise hosting](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/chapter-on-premise.html). And if you don't want to host Kimai, you can use the [Cloud version](https://www.kimai.cloud/) of it. ### Updating Kimai - [Update Kimai](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/updates.html) — get the latest version - [UPGRADING guide](UPGRADING.md) — version specific steps ### Plugins - [Plugins](https://www.kimai.org/store/) — paid and free plugin marketplace - [Developer documentation](https://www.kimai.org/documentation/developers.html) — how to create a plugin ## Roadmap and releases You can see a rough development [roadmap](https://roadmap.kimai.org/roadmap), which is open for changes and input from the community, your [ideas](https://roadmap.kimai.org/) are welcome. Release versions will be created on a regular basis, every couple of weeks latest. ## Contributing You want to contribute to this repository? This is so great! The best way to start is to open a [bug report](https://github.com/kimai/kimai/issues) or [feature request](https://roadmap.kimai.org) or a [discussion](https://github.com/kimai/kimai/discussions) for questions, support and such. In case you want to contribute, but you wouldn't know how, here are some suggestions: - Spread the word: Please [write a testimonial for our Wall of love](https://love.kimai.org), vote for Kimai on any software platform, you can toot or tweet about it, share it on LinkedIn, Reddit and any other social media platform! - [Translate Kimai into your language](https://hosted.weblate.org/engage/kimai/), or help to improve the existing translations, many languages look for a contributor - Answer questions: You know the answer to another user's problem? Share your knowledge. - Something can be done better? An essential feature is missing? Create a feature request. - Report bugs makes Kimai better for everyone. - You don't have to be programmer, the documentation and translation could always use some attention. - Sponsor the project: free software costs money to create! There is one simple rule in our "Code of conduct": Don't be an ass! ## Follow Kimai - Mastodon: [@kimai](https://phpc.social/@kimai) - Youtube: [@kimai_org](https://www.youtube.com/@kimai_org) - LinkedIn: [@kimai-org](https://www.linkedin.com/company/kimai-org/) - Reddit: [r/kimai](https://www.reddit.com/r/kimai/) ### Credits Kimai is based on modern technologies and frameworks such as [PHP](https://www.php.net/), [Symfony](https://github.com/symfony/symfony) and [Doctrine](https://github.com/doctrine/), [Bootstrap](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap) and [Tabler](https://tabler.io/), and [countless](composer.json) [others](package.json).
